title: AgentRunResultsPayload
description: Request body for POST /agent/run-results. Submitted by the management agent after completing a scheduled or manual run. Requires an agent JWT with scope agent:summaries:create.

AgentSummary.title: AgentSummary
AgentSummary.description: A single summary produced by the agent during a run. The server stores this as a SummaryDoc under the userId/orgId from the verified agent JWT.

sourceType.description: Source channel the summary was derived from.

sourceRefs.description: External identifiers (message IDs, email IDs) for the source documents.

rawText.description: Unprocessed source text used to generate this summary. Treat as potentially sensitive.

structured.description: Structured data extracted from the raw text.

tags.description: Categorisation tags applied by the agent.

suggestedPriority.description: Priority level the agent recommends for tasks derived from this summary.

reviewNeeded.description: Whether the agent believes the user should review before acting.

actionNeeded.description: Whether the agent has identified concrete action items.

taskCandidates.description: Task candidates proposed by the agent. These are stored but not created as Task documents until the user accepts them.

AgentSummarySection.title: AgentSummarySection
AgentSummarySection.description: A structured section within an agent-produced summary.

body.description: Full prose body of the section.

extractedBullets.description: Bullet points extracted from the section body.

TaskCandidate.title: TaskCandidate
TaskCandidate.description: A proposed task that the agent believes should be created. Stored on the Summary document; only promoted to a real Task when the user accepts it via POST /summaries/{id}/accept-tasks.

details.description: Extended description for the proposed task.

resourceType.description: Channel or system the request originated from.

requesterName.description: Name of the requester, if identified.

requesterContact.description: Contact info for the requester, if identified.

resourceLabel.description: Human-readable label for the source resource.

resourceUrl.description: Deep-link URL to the originating resource.

targetCompletionDate.description: Suggested deadline derived from the source material.

runType.description: Whether this run was triggered on a schedule or by a manual invocation.

sourcesChecked.description: List of source identifiers (mailbox IDs, channel IDs, etc.) the agent polled during this run.

summaries.description: Summaries produced during this run. The server stores each as a SummaryDoc scoped to the userId/orgId from the agent JWT.
